name: ECHO: Core
description: Shared services, contracts, registry utilities, and platform bootstrap infrastructure.
overview: ECHO: Core is the shared platform foundation for first-party ECHO modules. It defines the contracts, bootstrap vocabulary, and service patterns that let modules behave like parts of one ecosystem.

Core should stay boring and dependable: other modules rely on it for consistent registration, lifecycle, and platform identity while ECHO remains Minecraft/NeoForge-compatible today and evolves toward runtime-independent systems.
statusNote: Stable for the current public scope and treated as the baseline dependency for official modules.
roadmap: Keep shared contracts narrow and documented.
Improve diagnostics for missing or incompatible platform services.
Prepare contract boundaries for AdapterCore and future runtime work.

releaseNotes.title: Core registry foundation
notes: Defines base platform identity and shared service vocabulary.
Used by Ashfall and all current first-party module groups.

name: ECHO: NetCore
description: Networking, packets, server actions, sync, rate limiting, and debug tools.
overview: ECHO: NetCore provides the shared networking surface for packets, server actions, sync, and debug flows.
It keeps player-facing systems such as Terminal, Lens, HoloMap, and Ashfall route logic from inventing separate networking paths.
statusNote: Active and usable, with APIs expected to evolve as more modules share networking behavior.
roadmap: Document packet ownership rules.
Expose safer server action helpers.
Improve debug visibility for launcher and support reports.

releaseNotes.title: Shared networking surface
notes: Provides common networking language for first-party modules.
Supports current Minecraft/NeoForge-compatible module sync needs.

name: ECHO: DataCore
description: Persistent player and world data ownership, storage contracts, and migration-safe data structure.
overview: ECHO: DataCore owns persistent player and world data contracts for ECHO modules.
It exists so discoveries, mission state, unlocks, world markers, and Ashfall progression can be stored and migrated intentionally instead of becoming private module blobs.
statusNote: Active and central to Ashfall progression, with migration guidance still expanding.
roadmap: Add clearer ownership examples.
Improve module migration guidance.
Prepare PackOS compatibility checks for persistent data expectations.

releaseNotes.title: Persistent data contracts
notes: Defines shared persistence expectations for player and world state.
Supports mission, discovery, and progression systems.

name: ECHO: MissionCore
description: Mission, objective, reward, route, and feed backend for connected ECHO experiences.
overview: ECHO: MissionCore provides the mission, objective, route, reward, and feed backend for connected ECHO experiences.
It lets Terminal, HoloMap, and Ashfall content share progression state instead of each system tracking its own disconnected quest model.
statusNote: Active and important for Ashfall route identity; behavior may evolve as more official experiences appear.
roadmap: Document route and objective contracts.
Add clearer reward and feed examples.
Prepare mission validation for PackOS-aware releases.

releaseNotes.title: Mission backend foundation
notes: Supports route, objective, reward, and feed behavior.
Used by Terminal and Ashfall progression surfaces.

name: ECHO: WorldCore
description: Regions, hazards, markers, discoveries, overlays, and shared world vocabulary.
overview: ECHO: WorldCore defines shared world vocabulary: regions, hazards, markers, discoveries, overlays, and spatial state.
It helps Lens, HoloMap, Terminal, and Ashfall content talk about the same world facts without hard-coding every location into one UI.
statusNote: Active and used by Ashfall-facing systems; expected to grow as more world modules appear.
roadmap: Clarify marker and region contracts.
Add examples for hazards and discoveries.
Prepare adapter-safe world state boundaries.

releaseNotes.title: World vocabulary layer
notes: Defines shared spatial and hazard language.
Supports map, scanner, and progression systems.

name: ECHO: RenderCore
description: Shared rendering, particles, animation hooks, glow systems, and overlay helpers.
overview: ECHO: RenderCore provides shared rendering helpers for particles, overlays, glow systems, and animation hooks.
It is intentionally a support layer: official modules should use it for consistent visual effects without each feature inventing its own rendering conventions.
statusNote: Prototype: useful direction exists, but rendering APIs are expected to change as UI systems mature.
roadmap: Stabilize overlay helper APIs.
Document safe render lifecycle usage.
Prepare future ScreenCore and ThemeCore integration points.

releaseNotes.title: Rendering helper prototype
notes: Introduces shared rendering support for interface and world modules.
Marked prototype while the UI platform continues to evolve.

name: ECHO: Terminal
description: Mission, route, intel, reward, inbox, and addon-tab interface for ECHO experiences.
overview: ECHO: Terminal is the player command center for missions, routes, intel, rewards, inboxes, and addon tabs.
It is one of the clearest player-facing signals that ECHO is a platform: multiple modules can contribute to one coherent interface.
statusNote: Active and player-facing; used by Ashfall as a primary progression and intel surface.
roadmap: Document addon tab patterns.
Improve mission and route presentation examples.
Prepare themed UI support through future ThemeCore and ScreenCore.

releaseNotes.title: Terminal command center
notes: Supports mission, route, intel, reward, and inbox surfaces.
Designed for first-party modules to add tabs without forking the interface.

name: ECHO: HoloMap
description: Map interface for routes, crash sites, hazards, missions, bases, relays, and anomalies.
overview: ECHO: HoloMap is the spatial intelligence layer for routes, crash sites, hazards, relays, missions, bases, and anomalies.
It helps official experiences make world state readable while keeping discovery and mystery intact.
statusNote: Active and used by Ashfall route and world systems; overlay contracts may expand as more modules publish map data.
roadmap: Add overlay category guidance.
Improve marker lifecycle metadata.
Prepare future filter and route-planning support.

releaseNotes.title: Map overlay surface
notes: Provides route, hazard, mission, and world marker presentation.
Designed for modules to publish spatial data through shared providers.

name: ECHO: Lens
description: Scanner HUD for blocks, entities, fluids, machines, progression, and discoveries.
overview: ECHO: Lens is the scanner HUD for reading blocks, entities, fluids, machines, hazards, resources, and progression clues.
Lens turns discovery into an ECHO platform interaction by connecting scan results to Index, Terminal, HoloMap, and Ashfall progression.
statusNote: Active and central to Ashfall discovery; providers should remain careful about progression-gated information.
roadmap: Document provider reveal levels.
Add examples for hazards, machines, and hidden clues.
Connect scan results more directly to Index and HoloMap entries.

releaseNotes.title: Scanner provider surface
notes: Introduces a shared scanner HUD and provider model.
Supports world, machine, hazard, and progression discovery.

name: ECHO: Index
description: Item, recipe, usage, archive, and discovery system for ECHO-aware content.
overview: ECHO: Index is the knowledge system for items, recipes, archives, usage data, and discoveries.
Index gives players a platform-native way to understand what they found and why it matters without leaving the experience.
statusNote: Active and useful for Ashfall knowledge recovery; provider conventions should continue to mature.
roadmap: Document entry provider shape.
Improve unlock and discovery examples.
Connect archive entries to mission and scan events.

releaseNotes.title: Knowledge index surface
notes: Provides item, recipe, usage, and archive discovery patterns.
Supports module-provided entries instead of one manual global list.

name: SignalOS
description: Terminal and screen framework for experimental signal interface foundations.
overview: SignalOS is an experimental terminal and screen framework for signal-driven interface ideas.
It is not a default player-facing dependency yet, but it explores the visual and interaction language ECHO interfaces may use later.
statusNote: Experimental: useful for research, but not a stable public integration target.
roadmap: Prototype signal-oriented UI patterns.
Identify concepts that should move into ScreenCore or ThemeCore.
Avoid making player-facing stability promises until APIs settle.

releaseNotes.title: Signal UI experiment
notes: Explores terminal and screen-style interface foundations.
Marked experimental while interface direction is researched.

name: ECHO: Ashfall Protocol
description: Root campaign, survival loop, world state, route identity, and official experience layer.
overview: ECHO: Ashfall Protocol is the root experience layer for Ashfall. It defines the survival loop, world state, route identity, and campaign direction.
This module is intentionally pack-bound: it proves ECHO systems through Ashfall rather than acting as a standalone utility.
statusNote: Active and central to Ashfall; it should be described as the official experience layer, not a standalone platform dependency.
roadmap: Clarify route and survival contracts.
Connect more Ashfall modules through shared ECHO surfaces.
Prepare PackOS metadata for official release validation.

releaseNotes.title: Ashfall root layer
notes: Defines the first official ECHO experience identity.
Coordinates campaign, survival, and world-state systems.

name: ECHO: Orbital Remnants
description: Orbital route, launch chain, telemetry, caches, suit support, and crash infrastructure.
overview: ECHO: Orbital Remnants provides the orbital route, launch chain, telemetry, caches, suit support, and crash infrastructure for Ashfall.
It gives Ashfall a major progression vector tied to debris, orbital wreckage, and pre-Gridfall systems.
statusNote: Active Ashfall content layer with progression systems still expected to evolve.
roadmap: Expand orbital route docs.
Improve cache and telemetry integration examples.
Connect route state more clearly to HoloMap and Terminal.

releaseNotes.title: Orbital route foundation
notes: Adds orbital progression vocabulary for Ashfall.
Supports caches, telemetry, and crash-site infrastructure.

name: ECHO: Nexus Protocol
description: Nexus unlocks, anomaly storms, signal systems, route gates, and endgame bridges.
overview: ECHO: Nexus Protocol defines late-game anomaly, signal, route gate, and endgame bridge concepts for Ashfall.
It should feel mysterious and consequential, while remaining clearly marked as an evolving prototype until systems are stable.
statusNote: Prototype: the direction is important, but endgame systems should not be treated as stable yet.
roadmap: Prototype anomaly and signal behavior.
Define route gate contract expectations.
Document what late-game state other modules may consume.

releaseNotes.title: Nexus prototype layer
notes: Introduces late-game signal and anomaly direction.
Marked prototype while endgame systems are refined.

name: ECHO: Agriculture Reclamation
description: Food, reclamation, farming, survival recovery, and wasteland agriculture systems.
overview: ECHO: Agriculture Reclamation adds food, reclamation, farming, survival recovery, and wasteland agriculture systems for Ashfall.
It turns survival recovery into a platform-aware Ashfall subsystem rather than a disconnected farming feature.
statusNote: Prototype: useful survival direction exists, but balance and integration details should keep evolving.
roadmap: Define reclamation progression loops.
Connect crop and food data to Index and Lens.
Document survival recovery assumptions.

releaseNotes.title: Reclamation prototype
notes: Introduces agriculture and survival recovery direction.
Marked prototype while gameplay balance matures.

name: AdapterCore
description: Shared gameplay contract for Native Loader, NeoForge fallback, Standalone parity, resource bridges, registry bridges, and future runtime targets.
overview: AdapterCore is the shared gameplay contract between ECHO platform systems and runtime-specific hosts.

Native Loader is the primary future host, NeoForge remains compatibility fallback, and Standalone Runtime remains the parity harness. Native readiness still requires loaded classes, registered services, and real host mutation evidence.
statusNote: Active platform layer; critical to runtime-independent architecture, but not a finished native runtime by itself.
roadmap: Document adapter responsibilities.
Reduce runtime-specific leakage into modules.
Prepare future adapter metadata for PackOS and launcher flows.

releaseNotes.title: Adapter boundary direction
notes: Defines where runtime-specific assumptions should live.
Supports current Minecraft/NeoForge compatibility messaging.

name: ECHO PackOS
description: Package metadata, manifests, channels, release gates, lockfiles, and future pack integrity.
overview: ECHO PackOS is the validation and package layer for ECHO experiences.
It is designed around manifests, lockfiles, channels, release gates, snapshots, and integrity checks so official releases can be installed and repaired with confidence.
statusNote: In progress: architecture and docs are public-facing, but not every validation feature is implemented yet.
roadmap: Define manifest and lockfile schema.
Connect release gates to Command Center workflows.
Feed launcher repair and validation states.

releaseNotes.title: PackOS foundation
notes: Documents the validation/package layer direction.
Prepares the website and launcher for future release metadata.
